name: 97392 · Turner, OR
findings: ZIP 97392 (Turner) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97392 (Turner) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97392 (Turner) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 35% of the typical level).
